title: Integrating the first-order monotonicity ODE for I(t)/tⁿ
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let I, I₁, J₁, L: ℝ → ℝ, and let σ, ρ ∈ ℝ with 0 < σ ≤ ρ. Assume that for every τ ∈ [σ, ρ], I is differentiable at τ with derivative I₁(τ), and n·I(τ) − τ·I₁(τ) + τ·J₁(τ) + L(τ) = 0. Assume also that J₁ and L are continuous on [σ, ρ]. Then I(ρ)/ρⁿ − I(σ)/σⁿ = ∫_{(σ,ρ]} J₁(τ)/τⁿ dτ + ∫_{(σ,ρ]} L(τ)/τⁿ⁺¹ dτ, where ∫_{(σ,ρ]} is the Lebesgue integral over Ioc σ ρ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (I I₁ J₁ L : ℝ → ℝ) (σ ρ : ℝ), 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → (∀ τ ∈ Icc σ ρ, HasDerivAt I (I₁ τ) τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc σ ρ, (n : ℝ) * I τ - τ * I₁ τ + τ * J₁ τ + L τ = 0) → ContinuousOn J₁ (Icc σ ρ) → ContinuousOn L (Icc σ ρ) → I ρ / ρ ^ n - I σ / σ ^ n = (∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, J₁ τ / τ ^ n) + ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, L τ / τ ^ (n + 1)
